paragraphs: FastAPI lives in api/app/, Streamlit in ui/app.py, and the existing math archive in math/. Root main.py remains a compatibility API entrypoint. Start in offline mode: no API key, Postgres, PDF library, model download or paid API call is needed. Do not enter patient data. Existing scenario coefficients are unvalidated toy models, not treatment recommendations. The integrated physiology/ track includes a closed-form two-compartment passive-emptying teaching model. Broader respiratory and hemodynamic models remain future work; none of these models is validated for patient care.

The web demo and navierstokes/ now distinguish synthetic waveforms from an incomplete conjecture. See corrections and analytical checks and the retired-claim ledger. No conditional regularity theorem or clinical-to-PDE equivalence is established by those tools.
